Level0 attempt 1 reached CMake with upstream Python bindings enabled and failed because ECMGeneratePythonBindings could not import the Python build module.
Attempt 2 reached wheel generation and failed because setuptools.build_meta was unavailable. Preserve upstream Python bindings and provide the missing Resolute backend.

Attempt 3 compiled KJobWidgets successfully with 3/3 tests PASS, but dpkg-gensymbols observed _ZSt19piecewise_construct@Base as a new libstdc++/toolchain-dependent export and Lintian rejected the generated current Debian revision. Model it as an optional private/toolchain symbol at upstream version 6.30.0 rather than as KDE public ABI.

source_build_relation_overrides.rationale: ECMGeneratePythonBindings requires the Python 'build' frontend when BUILD_PYTHON_BINDINGS=ON; Ubuntu Resolute provides it via python3-build.
The upstream wheel build uses setuptools.build_meta under python -m build --no-isolation; Resolute python3-build does not depend on python3-setuptools.
